jei.mythic_companions.instructions: Feed an eligible wild prehistoric creature repeatedly. Small and peaceful creatures bond faster; apex predators take more trust. Sneak-use with an empty hand to toggle follow or stay.
jei.mythic_companions.species: %s uses this pack's diet bonding. Each accepted food has a 1-in-%s chance. Habitat: %s.
jei.mythic_companions.habitat.aquatic: water; follows or teleports only while its owner is swimming
jei.mythic_companions.anurognathus: Native taming: feed juniper berries to an Anurognathus. Each berry has a 1-in-3 chance.
jei.mythic_companions.hippocampus: Native taming: feed a Hippocampus cod, cooked cod, salmon, cooked salmon, pufferfish, or tropical fish.
jei.mythic_companions.triceratops: Native taming: feed a wild Triceratops grass blocks until it trusts riders, then use a Woolly Saddle. Feed the resulting rideable Trike herbivore foods to bond it as a companion.
